topic: Museum that houses the Mona Lisa
core_question: In which museum is the Mona Lisa permanently displayed? (secondary: Which language uses the Hangul writing system created in the 15th century by King Sejong?)
answer_summary: The answer must name the Louvre (in Paris, France) as the museum housing the Mona Lisa.; after the topic shift: The answer must name Korean as the language that uses the Hangul writing system.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing in full careful sentences
